people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

translations.web: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told the dream before them; but they didn’t make known to me its interpretation.
translations.bsb: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers, and diviners came in, I told them the dream, but they could not interpret it for me.
translations.kjv: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation
translations.asv: Then came in the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers; and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.
